Add 1 tsp salt to buttermilk 42. Add 1/2 tsp pepper to buttermilk 43. Add 1/2 tsp garlic powder to buttermilk 44. Stir buttermilk mix 45. Pour buttermilk over chicken 46. Mix with hands to coat all 47. Make sure all pieces are covered 48. Cover bowl with cling wrap / plate 49. Put in fridge 50. Set timer 1 hour minimum 51. Wait 52. After 1 hour, take chicken out 53. Get one chicken piece with tongs 66. Let excess marinade drip 3 seconds 67. Drop into flour bowl 68. Roll it in flour 69. Press flour on top 70. Flip it 71. Press flour on other side 72. Shake off extra flour gently 73. Put breaded piece on clean plate 74. Repeat step 65 for piece #2 75. Repeat for piece #3 76. Repeat for piece #4 77. Repeat for piece #5 78. Repeat for piece #6 79. Repeat for piece #7 80. Repeat for piece #8 81. You should have 8 pieces coated 82. Look at flour bowl - add more if low 83. Let all breaded chicken rest 84. Set timer 10 mins 85. This makes breading stick - don't skip 86. While waiting, clean marinade bowl 87. Wash hands 88. Check chicken - flour should look a bit wet now 89. That means it's ready to fry 90. Don't touch it 109. Let it fry 110. Check bottom - should be golden 111. When timer rings, flip with tongs 112. Flip piece #1 113. Flip piece #2 114. Flip piece #3 115. Set timer 7 mins again 116. Wait again 117. Don't poke it too much 118. Check oil - if too hot, lower to low-medium 119. If too pale, raise a bit to medium 120. After 7 mins, check color 121. Should be deep golden brown 122. Poke thickest part - juice should be clear 123. If unsure, cut small piece 124. If pink inside, fry 2 more mins 125. If golden, lift with tongs 126. Let oil drip 5 seconds 127.
